# PreventPageBreak

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Keeps its child together: if the child will not fit in the space left on the current page but would fit on an empty one, the whole child moves to the next page rather than splitting across the boundary.

This is the element form of the `breakAllowed` property (spec "Layout & Pagination" §7), and behaves identically. Prefer the property when you own the element; prefer this wrapper when you do not - around a subtree you were handed, or where an options bag would be noise.

A child taller than a whole content box still splits: the spec requires it, because no page break can rescue content that fits on no page at all.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`. Extends `PaginationWrapperBase`.

## Constructors

```typescript
new PreventPageBreak()
new PreventPageBreak(options: PreventPageBreakOptions)
new PreventPageBreak(child: IElement)
```
